identitySignals: OUSD Board memo 25-2750 names 'Design For Equity LLC, Oakland, CA', matching the agenda text
OUSD memo says the firm provides leadership coaching for supervisors in Community Schools and Student Services, consistent with the contract titles

Search results describe a small Oakland consulting firm of the same name, but no official website or public business registry entry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) could be found or fetched to confirm
research.notes: Appears to be a very small consultancy; no official website or registry page found. A directory-style address and phone surfaced in search snippets but could not be traced to a citable business page and may be a residence, so they were omitted. Not publishable without a registry or website confirmation.

profile.summary: Design For Equity LLC is an Oakland, California company that provides individual and group leadership coaching for supervisors, according to a Board of Education memo from Oakland Unified School District.
